scripts.text:
[Shone]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Hodes?
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
你打完50只蚯蚓了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Shone]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
嗯，我覺得你還沒打夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Shone]
Remember, I need help hunting Hodes so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
記住，我需要你幫忙打蚯蚓，去把50只都打完吧。

scripts.text:
[Shone]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
你確定要停止狩獵嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Shone]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Shone]
Please kill 50 Hodes.
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
請擊殺50只蚯蚓。

scripts.text:
[Shone]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
真厲害，你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Shone]
I am trying to collect ^00CE0025 Earthworm Peelings^000000.
I will reward you if you help.
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
我正在收集^00CE0025個蚯蚓皮^000000。
如果你能幫我，我會給你獎勵。

scripts.text: I have 25 Earthworm Peelings
scripts.translation: 我有25個蚯蚓皮

scripts.text: What was it again?
scripts.translation: 剛才是什麼來著？

scripts.text:
Thank you for the 25 Earthworm
Peelings!
Here is that reward I promised you, I hope take this wisdom I have passed on to you and share it with others.
scripts.translation:
謝謝你帶來了25個蚯蚓皮！
這是答應給你的獎勵。希望你能把這份智慧傳遞給其他人。

scripts.text:
[Shone]
I don't see any ^00CE00Earthworm Peerlings^000000.
Are you trying to scam me?
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
我沒看到任何^00CE00蚯蚓皮^000000。
你想騙我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shone]
I need ^00CE0025 Earthworm Peelings^000000.

[Shone]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Hodes.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[肖恩]
啊，看來你可以幫我打一些蚯蚓。
你想打多少隻？

scripts.text: 50 Hodes
scripts.translation: 50只蚯蚓

scripts.text: 100 Hodes
scripts.translation: 100只蚯蚓

scripts.text: 150 Hodes
scripts.translation: 150只蚯蚓

scripts.text:

You need some help, but I can't provide that for you.
Come back when you are stronger and have earned much more wisdom.
scripts.translation:

你需要一些幫助，但我無法提供。
等你變強並積累更多智慧後再來吧。
